transcript_full_pass: Your own playlists on an airplane seatback screen. New on November 5, your Spotify login on United seatbacks. Join the plane's Wi-Fi, no pass needed, then scan the QR code. Your playlists and podcasts appear, right where you left off. Your password never touches the screen. It logs out after the flight. The catch? Only United planes with Starlink for now, but more are coming. Follow Media Diet for Technology Explained.
